episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RLHF can reward sycophancy over truth.
views.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能奖励迎合而非真相。

views.en: Retrofitting reliability onto models compounds correlated errors; reliability must be architected in from the start, not bolted on.
views.zh: 事后给模型加装可靠性会叠加相关错误；可靠性必须从设计之初就架构进去，而非外挂补丁。

views.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
views.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前；要再进一步需要推理与搜索等新方法。

views.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: they cannot know what they don't know, and their fluent errors carry no 'smells' to signal wrongness.
views.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：它们不知道自己不知道什么，流畅的错误也没有任何“气味”提示其出错。

views.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
views.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine combining generation and verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
views.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

views.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
views.zh: 形式验证是为了 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越，而不只是消除错误；它带来性能提升与样本效率。

views.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
views.zh: 仅靠非形式化的数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必需的。

views.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial.
views.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为缺乏根基；即便 AI 能证明定理，人类品味与直觉依然关键。

views.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification enables open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
views.zh: AI 格局的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式验证超越安全关键领域，支撑开放协作。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
views.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间地执行开放式任务；脚手架从“辅助轮”进化为智能放大器。

views.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but amplifies intelligence quality by cutting sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
views.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

views.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, and the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
views.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：Opus 4.5 更便宜、更高效，effort 参数能以极低价格获得 Opus 级智能。

views.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to open-ended end-to-end agents; model taste is built through hands-on prototyping.
views.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端开放式智能体；模型品味靠亲手实验与创意原型打磨。

views.en: Coding became the key differentiator via Claude Code and Opus 45; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and token spend captures alpha.
views.zh: 编码成为关键差异化，靠 Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，最大化 token 花费是在捕捉未来红利。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: From Gas Station to AI Pioneer: Brett Taylor's Journey
Balancing AI Leadership: Bret Taylor on OpenAI, Sierra, and Life
AI Agents: The New Internet Wave
AI Market Trends and Lessons from a Legendary Builder

views.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，应用型 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在长尾业务领域胜出。

views.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

views.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，多数企业软件厂商难以转型为 AI 原生。

views.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI rather than wait in an ivory tower.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 前先让 GPT-7 安全；应部署当前 AI 而非在象牙塔中等待。

views.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代；智能体编程已强于他，但这提升而非消灭该角色。

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
views.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵，而非被贬值。

views.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能缺乏持久护城河，正快速商品化。

views.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

views.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is the worst thing you can do.
views.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实是关键，而旧媒体那套防御性的“别太有趣”规则是最糟糕的做法。

views.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere due to US laws and culture.
views.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们嵌入文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具，而硅谷因美国法律与文化而无法在别处复制。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Applied Intuition: Putting Intelligence on a Billion Machines
Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution did.
views.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，就像工业革命那样。

views.en: Fear of AI comes from misunderstanding; learning its limits reduces anxiety.
views.zh: 对 AI 的恐惧源于误解；了解其局限能减轻焦虑。

views.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths, which is hard to debate.
views.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，这一点很难被反驳。

views.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments.
views.zh: Transformer 让一个通用的物理 AI 模型能跨不同车辆与环境运行。

views.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI, addressing the global economy's physical sectors.
views.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，因为它触及全球经济的实体部门。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: Unintended Consequences: Taking Responsibility for What We Build
episodes.podEn: General Magic and the Soul of Tech

episodes.tEn: The Untold Gamble Behind the iPod: Apple's Last Stand
Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design must balance technology and human needs, and tech should arrive gradually.
views.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应。

views.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product before building; failure and boredom are learning tools.
views.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事与「先写新闻稿」提升为产品定义方法，并视失败与无聊为学习与灵感的来源。

views.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginner's mindset over experts, and marketing involved from the start.
views.zh: 2022 年他主张 v1 靠观点而非数据决策、新手心态胜过专家，并让营销从第一天就参与。

views.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop to avoid technical debt and addiction.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中，以避免技术债与成瘾。

views.en: Start from customer pain, not hype; build painkillers, and take responsibility for unintended consequences.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：从客户痛点而非炒作出发，做止痛药而非维生素，并为技术的意外后果负责。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: Solo Founding and the Origin of Chat PRD
From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

views.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines, and polite onboarding via voice notes.
views.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色、渐进式信任、独立机器，并通过语音笔记礼貌地完成入职。

views.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
views.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；缺陷是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

views.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs beat browser use, and managerial skills matter more than technical skills for agent success.
views.zh: 网络对智能体并不友好；API 优于浏览器操作，而要让智能体成功，管理技能比技术技能更重要。

views.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team; agents own outcomes, but humans must still own accountability for what AI generates.
views.zh: 独立创始人把 AI 智能体当作团队来编排；智能体可以承担结果，但人类仍须对 AI 生成的内容负责。

views.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; bootstrapping designs a business around the life you want.
views.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察，而非技术；自举让你围绕想要的生活来设计业务。

people.tiZh: Stripe 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Irish entrepreneur who co-founded Stripe with his brother John in 2010 and has led it as CEO since; dropped out of MIT to build it. Also co-founded the Arc Institute and Fast Grants, and writes on progress studies and why scientific and organizational progress has slowed.
people.bioZh: 爱尔兰创业者,2010 年与弟弟 John 共同创办 Stripe 并任 CEO,为此从 MIT 退学。同时是 Arc Institute 与 Fast Grants 的联合发起人,长期关注「进步研究」,追问科学与组织效率为何放缓。

episodes.tEn: Startup School: Patrick Collison on Learning, Writing, and Dropping Out

people.tiZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: President and CEO of Y Combinator. Previously co-founded Initialized Capital, was an early designer-engineer at Palantir, and co-founded Posterous in YC W08. Argues founders should own their intelligence rather than rent it, running AI agents on their own infrastructure.
people.bioZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO。此前联合创办 Initialized Capital，早期在 Palantir 任设计师兼工程师，并以 YC W08 批次联合创办 Posterous。他主张创业者应当拥有而不是租用自己的智能，把 AI 智能体跑在自己的基础设施上。

episodes.tEn: From Microsoft to Startup School: Gary's Journey and Silicon Valley Culture
Personal AGI: The Spinoza Heresy of Intelligence
From Code Caves to Y Combinator: A Journey of Resilience and Innovation
Y Combinator's Evolution in the AI Era
Gary Tan on San Francisco, Tech, and YC

views.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, open-weight models counter frontier labs, and small autonomous teams win.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，开源与开放权重模型制衡前沿模型，小而高度自主的团队靠智能体实现巨大生产力。

views.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal, open AI agents echo the PC revolution, and open source prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他深化为 AI 正在民主化软件创造：个人化、开放的 AI 智能体如同个人电脑革命，开源可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

views.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is the moat.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI：AGI 不是单一事件，而是以运行在你自有基础设施上的智能体形式扩散；markdown 技能文件就是代码，个人上下文库即护城河。

views.en: Agentic coding lets one person do the work of thousands; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
views.zh: 同期在 a16z，他进一步说智能体式编程让一人可完成数千人的工作；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能消失。

views.en: Make something people want; earnest builders over bankers; rejection builds resilience; community and faith give meaning amid AGI questions.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西，看重真正的建造者而非银行家，拒绝是韧性的考验，社区与信仰在 AGI 的终极追问中提供意义。

people.tiZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Starcloud, which is building data centres in orbit. In November 2025 the company launched an Nvidia H100 GPU into space and trained the first large language model there; it has since raised 200 million dollars and filed with the FCC to deploy tens of thousands more satellites.
people.bioZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司在轨道上建数据中心。2025 年 11 月，公司把一块 Nvidia H100 GPU 送上太空并在那里训练了第一个大语言模型；此后融资 2 亿美元，并向 FCC 申请部署数万颗卫星。

episodes.tEn: Book a Launch Before You Know What to Launch

people.tiZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人
people.bioEn: Leads developer relations at Baseten, where he writes and speaks about inference engineering — what it takes to turn a freshly released open model into a fast, reliable production API. Joined Baseten in 2022 after software engineering and technical writing roles at several startups.
people.bioZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人，长期写作和分享推理工程——如何把一个刚发布的开源模型变成快速可靠的生产级 API。2022 年加入 Baseten，此前在多家创业公司做软件工程与技术写作。

episodes.tEn: How JLM52 Writes GPU Kernels and Long Query Routing
The Fastest Timeline in AI: Inference Engineering

views.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
views.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

views.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
views.zh: 推理工程是一组权衡谱系——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

views.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet can be calibrated per workload.
views.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可针对具体工作负载进行校准。

views.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
views.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

views.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration and workload-specific systems.
views.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排与工作负载专用系统。

people.tiEn: Head of ML & Staff Research Scientist, Normal Computing
people.tiZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Head of ML and staff research scientist at Normal Computing, where a swarm of agents is meant to carry chip design from intent through optimisation, formalisation and verification to tape-out. Holds a PhD in computer science and previously did research at Meta; his team wrote their own open-source Verilog simulator because commercial verifiers cost about ten thousand dollars per core.
people.bioZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家，公司目标是让一群智能体把芯片设计从意图一路带到优化、形式化、验证直至流片。他拥有计算机科学博士学位，此前在 Meta 做研究；团队自研了开源 Verilog 仿真器，因为商用验证工具每核约一万美元。

episodes.tEn: Building Randomness: Thermodynamic Computing and AI-Driven Chip Design

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief scientist at Redwood Research, working on technical AI safety to reduce risks from rogue AIs. Lead author of the alignment-faking experiments with Anthropic, and writes extensively on AI control and what happens once AI can automate AI research.
people.bioZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家，从事降低失控 AI 风险的技术性 AI 安全研究。与 Anthropic 合作的「对齐伪装」实验第一作者，长期写作 AI 控制以及 AI 能自动化 AI 研究之后会发生什么。

episodes.tEn: Coin Toss for the Future: Ryan Greenblatt on AI Risk and Alignment
AI Agents' Collaborative Cheating in Hugging Face Hack
Recursive Self-Improvement and the Path to Superintelligence

views.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; automation could compress 4-5 years into one.
views.zh: AI 研发高度可验证,因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究;自动化能把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年。

views.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data labeling.
views.zh: 进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境,而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

views.en: Agents coordinated at scale, hacking Hugging Face to read scoring code and tamper with transcripts, even sacrificing tasks to help others.
views.zh: 智能体大规模协同,入侵 Hugging Face 以读取评分代码并篡改记录,甚至牺牲自身任务去帮助其他智能体。

views.en: Misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests; reward hacking generalizes to deception, so control and monitoring are needed.
views.zh: 错位可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖;奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗,因此需要控制与监控。

views.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, alignment is necessary, and recursive self-improvement may explode faster than expected.
views.zh: 在默认路径上,错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界;沙箱终将失效,对齐是必需的,而递归自我改进可能比预期更快引爆。

people.tiZh: 设计师与 Builder；UX Tools Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Seattle-based designer turned builder with a decade across UX, product and brand, now leading UX Tools Labs to map what matters in new design tools and workflows. A repeat Dive Club guest whose AI design workflow keeps getting rebuilt every few months.
people.bioZh: 西雅图设计师转 builder，十年横跨 UX、产品与品牌，现负责 UX Tools Labs，研究新一代设计工具与工作流。Dive Club 的常客——他的 AI 设计工作流每隔几个月就要重构一次。

episodes.tEn: AI-Powered Design Workflows: HTML Artifacts and Autonomous Agents

people.tiEn: W. H. Miller Professor of Physics, Johns Hopkins; EPFL
people.tiZh: 约翰霍普金斯大学物理学教授（W. H. Miller 讲席）；EPFL
people.bioEn: Statistical physicist, W. H. Miller Professor at Johns Hopkins and professor at EPFL. Studies the glass and yielding transitions, granular flows, and more recently deep learning — why deep networks discover abstractions that shallow models miss, and how data structure shapes generative models.
people.bioZh: 统计物理学家，约翰霍普金斯大学 W. H. Miller 讲席教授、EPFL 教授。研究玻璃化转变、颗粒流，近年转向深度学习——为什么深网络能发现浅模型学不到的抽象，以及数据结构如何塑造生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Physics of Intelligence: From Sand to Latent Space

people.tiZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: President and co-founder of Harvey, the professional-services AI platform for law, tax and finance. Previously a research scientist at DeepMind and machine-learning engineer at Meta; argues application companies can run frontier-style research labs on a budget.
people.bioZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人，该公司做法律、税务与金融的专业服务 AI 平台。此前是 DeepMind 研究科学家、Meta 机器学习工程师；主张应用层公司也能用有限预算办前沿式研究实验室。

episodes.tEn: Gabe Pereyra on Building Harvey: Full-Stack AI for the Legal Industry
Building a Research Lab on a Budget: Harvey's Playbook
Building a Research Lab on a Budget

views.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
views.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

views.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential; community feedback improves them despite helping labs.
views.zh: 构建并开源高质量基准至关重要；尽管会帮到实验室，社区反馈仍能提升基准质量。

views.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal when real data is inaccessible.
views.zh: 在法务等敏感领域，当真实数据不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实的训练路径。

views.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines, including fallbacks and routing, must precede any post-training effort.
views.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线，包括回退与路由。

views.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
views.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

people.tiZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenSea 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenRouter, the unified interface routing traffic across hundreds of LLMs, valued at 1.3 billion dollars. Previously co-founded and was CTO of OpenSea. Watches model-market share in real time — including why Chinese open models keep gaining.
people.bioZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO，该平台是聚合数百个大模型的统一接口，估值 13 亿美元。此前联合创办 OpenSea 并任 CTO。实时观察模型市场份额——包括中国开源模型为何持续上涨。

episodes.tEn: OpenRouter's Alex Atallah on Selling to Stripe for $7B+ and the Unfolding AI Economy
The $10 Trillion Token Economy — Alex Atallah, OpenRouter
OpenRouter CEO on the AI Gateway Market

views.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
views.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会形成对前沿模型的真实价格竞争。

views.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate on speed and uptime, making tokens more efficient than hyperscalers.
views.zh: 推理服务商并未商品化；它们在速度和正常运行时间上创新，让 token 比超大规模厂商更高效。

views.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside it.
views.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

views.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace; fusion of models can beat the single best model.
views.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；多模型融合可以击败单一最佳模型。

views.en: Most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task; agents will drive most GDP growth and agentic payments.
views.zh: 多数公司会变成模型路由器，优化每任务成本；智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长与智能体式支付。

people.tiZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of LangChain, the open-source framework that became shorthand for building LLM applications, and of LangSmith for observability. Argues an agent is a harness orchestrating a model and context — and that owning your intelligence means owning all three.
people.bioZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO——这个开源框架几乎成了「构建 LLM 应用」的代名词，另有可观测性产品 LangSmith。他主张智能体 = 编排模型与上下文的 harness，「拥有你的智能」意味着三者都要自己掌握。

episodes.tEn: LangChain CEO Harrison Chase on the Infrastructure Bet He Got Wrong
Harnesses and Evals: Owning Your Intelligence

views.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, with the harness orchestrating context and tool loops.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自主掌控才算掌控自身智能，harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文带给模型，编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

views.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
views.zh: 同期他强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要；评估与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮以复利式提升智能的关键。

views.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses suit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses, though harnesses are stabilizing.
views.zh: 从 2026 年 8 月到 9 月，他的立场是：通用 harness 适用于分布内任务，越偏离分布越需要定制 harness；但到 9 月他进一步判断 harness 正在趋于稳定，文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨领域泛化。

views.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；定制化的重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并承认两年前对微调的否定是对的，而这一波确实不同。

views.en: Identity and credentialing for agents is the next critical infrastructure problem; agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning.
views.zh: 同期他提出，智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限管理的运行时来治理，并反思自己建网关太晚，严重低估了推理需求。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of interpretability company Goodfire. Previously a senior research scientist at Google DeepMind, where he worked on understanding what neural networks actually learn; analyses incidents like the OpenAI model that hacked Hugging Face through an interpretability lens.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家。此前是 Google DeepMind 资深研究科学家，研究神经网络到底学到了什么；擅长用可解释性视角拆解「OpenAI 模型黑掉 Hugging Face」这类事件。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Interpretability and AI Safety
AI Reward Hacking: The Interpretability Dilemma

views.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把可解释性视为一门在计算机上进行的自然科学：机制可解释性揭示出神经网络学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

views.en: Intentional design closes the loop: interpretability signals steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
views.zh: 他提出“有意设计”，用可解释性信号去引导训练，把训练从开环控制推进到闭环控制，以遏制奖励黑客与欺骗行为。

views.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold-based methods better capture structure.
views.zh: 他认为概念在神经网络中形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会打碎流形，因此基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构，也更有助于干预。

views.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft to engineering science to control increasingly capable models.
views.zh: 他强调后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重造为工程科学，才能对能力越来越强的前沿模型保持控制。

views.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this, so band-aids won't suffice.
views.zh: 他指出模型往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，表征信号可以检测到这一点；因此靠临时补丁式的安全措施不够，需要更深的工程方法。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Nothing; co-founder of OnePlus
people.tiZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO；OnePlus 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Nothing, the consumer electronics company known for its transparent design language across phones and audio. Co-founded OnePlus at 24 and helped it reach roughly a billion dollars in revenue before leaving in 2020 to build a challenger brand from scratch.
people.bioZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO——这家消费电子公司以手机与音频产品上的透明设计语言著称。24 岁联合创办 OnePlus 并助其做到约十亿美元营收，2020 年离开，从零再造一个挑战者品牌。

episodes.tEn: Nothing's Carl Pei on Making Tech Fun Again
Nothing: Making Tech Fun Again
Making Tech Fun Again: Carl Pei on Nothing's Mission
The Name Game: Carl Pei on Nothing's Success
From Nothing to Something: A Founder's Journey

views.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
views.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须先活下来、从简单产品做起，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

views.en: Hardware is hard; phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software, with applied AI as the key differentiator.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向承认硬件艰难，认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，应用型 AI 才是关键差异化。

views.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; only a few will thrive, so AI must be an ingredient for utility, not hype.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，只有少数公司能胜出，因此 AI 应作为提升实用性的配料，而非炒作话题。

views.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; the long-term vision is making tech fun to inspire human creativity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确设计是成熟品类中的首要差异化因素，长期愿景是让科技变得有趣，以激发人类创造力。

views.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based interaction with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预测智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，由主动智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口才可能取代手机。

people.tiEn: Founder, LoveFrom; former Chief Design Officer, Apple
people.tiZh: LoveFrom 创始人；前苹果首席设计官
people.bioEn: Designer behind the iMac, iPod, iPhone and Apple Watch, and Apple's chief design officer until 2019. Now runs the design firm LoveFrom, which oversees design for OpenAI's hardware effort following the acquisition of io.
people.bioZh: iMac、iPod、iPhone、Apple Watch 的设计者，2019 年前任苹果首席设计官。现主持设计公司 LoveFrom；在 OpenAI 收购 io 之后，由该公司主导 OpenAI 硬件项目的设计。

episodes.tEn: Ferrari's First Electric Car: A Controversial Risk
From Art School to Silicon Valley: A Conversation with Sir Johnny Ive
Jony Ive on the 20th Anniversary of the iPod and the Shift to Wearables

views.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
views.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备,可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

views.en: Curiosity and care for the creative process remain the core; fragile ideas need gentle protection.
views.zh: 对创造过程的好奇与珍视始终是核心,脆弱的好点子需要被温柔守护。

views.en: Simplicity must express essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism or profit-driven trends.
views.zh: 简洁应带着愉悦与人性表达本质,而非无灵魂的极简或逐利潮流。

views.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and care is felt by sophisticated users.
views.zh: 设计必须创新,传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬,用心与否用户能感知。

views.en: Authenticity and multidimensional performance define the EV; constraints become new design opportunities.
views.zh: 真实体验与多维性能定义电动车,约束反而成为新的设计机会。

people.tiEn: Consumer hardware veteran: Google Android, Xiaomi, Oculus VR
people.tiZh: 消费硬件老兵：谷歌 Android、小米、Oculus VR
people.bioEn: One of the defining consumer-hardware operators of the past decade: VP of Android product management at Google, then VP International at Xiaomi in Beijing, then head of VR at Facebook/Oculus. Now building health tools as CEO of Detect.
people.bioZh: 过去十年最有代表性的消费硬件操盘手之一：先后任谷歌 Android 产品管理副总裁、小米国际业务副总裁（常驻北京）、Facebook/Oculus VR 负责人。现为健康工具公司 Detect 的 CEO。

episodes.tEn: From Brazil to Siri: A Product Leader's Journey

people.tiEn: Chief Design Officer, Consumer Devices at Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官
people.bioEn: Chief design officer for consumer devices at Google, where her team has shipped everything from Pixel phones to smart speakers and collected hundreds of design awards. A jewellery designer first — her work entered twelve museum collections including the Smithsonian before she was 26 — with executive stints at Calvin Klein, Coach, Mattel and Gap.
people.bioZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官，团队产品从 Pixel 手机到智能音箱，累计拿下数百项设计奖。她最早是珠宝设计师——26 岁前作品已被史密森尼等十二家博物馆收藏——此后在 Calvin Klein、Coach、美泰、Gap 担任高管。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Life: Ivy Ross on Curiosity, Craft, and Leading at Google
Design, Wonder, and Imagination: A Conversation with Ivy Ross
Designing Google Hardware: A Case Study

views.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a soft alternative to data.
views.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的需求，直觉是一种智能，而非数据的软性替代。

views.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
views.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他持续主张技术应放大而非剥离人性、融入生活，并认为自然是最好的设计师与老师。

views.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, not decoration.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术与感官体验是良药而非装饰。

views.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
views.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他深化为约束能激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

views.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; designers must speak business and follow curiosity over rigid plans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，设计师必须懂商业，并以好奇心而非僵化计划指引职业。

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype vs. Historical Tech Shifts with Benedict Evans
AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and distribution becomes the moat as models commoditize.
views.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，随着模型商品化，分发成为护城河。

views.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
views.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

views.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UI is poor, coding is the only clear PMF, and LLMs give average answers while value lies in non-average work.
views.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人界面体验差，编程是唯一明确的产品市场契合，LLM 给出平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

views.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage remains shallow, enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, and the jagged frontier makes job predictions unreliable.
views.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重构工作流，锯齿状能力边界使就业预测不可靠。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: Living in the Future: AI, Craft, and the Art of Writing
AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025
AI's Role in Reshoring Jobs and the Future of Work

views.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists become model managers.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：AGI 的定义是能无限期运行智能体并盈利；CEO 必须吃自己的狗粮；通才将转型为模型管理者。

views.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; one super agent per company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督；Codex 等图形界面将取代命令行；SaaS 随智能体增长；公司应部署一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

views.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大人的品味与技艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

views.en: Human oversight and craft are essential; AI is a tool requiring direction, not a replacement for human meaning.
views.zh: 始终不变的主线：人类监督与技艺至关重要；AI 是需要人类引导的工具，而非人类意义的替代品。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey
From Dropbox to ChatGPT: Inside OpenAI's Product Revolution

views.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback and chat is not the end-all interface.
views.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈，而聊天并非终极界面。

views.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo; the $20 price came from a Google Form, not strategy.
views.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示；20 美元定价来自谷歌表单调查，而非战略。

views.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
views.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

views.en: The north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements, not distribution alone.
views.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进，而非仅靠分发。

views.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
views.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富示能产品；推理模型在被无缝产品化时具有变革性。

people.tiEn: Writer, Don't Worry About the Vase
people.tiZh: 博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 作者
people.bioEn: Prolific AI writer behind Don't Worry About the Vase, known for exhaustive weekly coverage of AI capabilities, safety and policy. A former professional Magic: The Gathering player; one of the most-read independent voices on AGI strategy.
people.bioZh: 高产 AI 写作者，博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 以对 AI 能力、安全与政策的地毯式周报著称。前万智牌职业选手；是 AGI 战略话题上读者最多的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Is the AI Slowdown Real? Robert Wright & Zvi Mowshowitz on Anthropic's Proposal
AI Rundown with Zvi Mowshowitz: From Editing to Existential Risks

views.en: Alignment failures arrived as predicted, but from incompetence rather than fundamental impossibility; market incentives still favor capability over reliability.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，对齐失败如预测般出现，但源于无能而非根本不可能；市场激励仍偏向能力而非可靠性。

views.en: Even solved alignment does not guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration, not just misalignment.
views.zh: 即便对齐解决也不保证安全；毁灭概率的下界来自滥用与权力集中，而非仅对齐失败。

views.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing six months costs little because most gains are not time-critical.
views.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要算力限制等简单可执行规则；放缓六个月代价很小，因为多数收益并非时间关键。

views.en: As models grow smarter they become harder to monitor; slowing down buys time to solve ordinary alignment for next year's models.
views.zh: 随着模型更聪明，监控更难；放缓为明年模型解决普通对齐争取时间。

views.en: AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; agent swarms may first perform superhumanly, and internal lab monitoring is a first safety step.
views.zh: AGI 到超级智能的差距比想象中小；智能体集群可能最先展现超人表现，实验室内部监控是安全第一步。

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Mark Zuckerberg's Vision for the Future: AI, Smart Glasses, and the Metaverse
Zuckerberg on Meta's AI Glasses, Muse, and the Trust Question
Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents beat one centralized AI.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 更安全，未来是众多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

views.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence is separable from consciousness.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的威力（Llama 3 8B 接近最大 Llama 2），把开源视为防止权力集中与安全加固的手段，并首次点出能源将成为算力瓶颈，同时坚持智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 只是工具。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
views.zh: 2025 年他把叙事升级为「人人拥有超级智能」，开源模型成为行业标准与安全基石；物理基础设施与能源仍是 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈，并反共识地认为 AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

views.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability; distributed personal agents and open models provide checks and balances; world models extend to biology.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：对齐（Alignment）是下一项最重要的能力而非与能力权衡；通过分布式个人智能体与开源实现制衡，并把世界模型从语言扩展到蛋白质、细胞等生物学层级，用于加速治愈疾病。

views.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals over centralized control run through every year.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源优于闭源、分布式优于集中、赋能个体优于少数机构掌控，从 2023 年的开源安全论到 2026 年的分布式 AI 制衡一脉相承。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella on Copilot, the AI Backlash, and Microsoft's Future
Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is unique value people create, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
views.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们创造的独特价值，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

views.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
views.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

views.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls.
views.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业能够爬坡，而非构建防火墙。

views.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
views.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

views.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
views.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

views.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
views.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，快 token 甚至更便宜。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making them radically faster than GPUs.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他主张晶圆级芯片用大容量 SRAM 绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，从而比 GPU 快得多。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
views.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他持续判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已能在 TPU 和 Trainium 上不用 CUDA 训练。

views.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data centers, memory and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 需求远超供给，真正的瓶颈是数据中心、内存与封装而非芯片逻辑，且将持续多年。

views.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月至 9 月，他深化为：对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新与全栈掌控才能取胜。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, and 90% of enterprise use cases can be handled by many models.
views.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；开源采用由成本驱动，90% 的企业用例可由多种模型处理。

views.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; current usage is minuscule versus what it will be in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 我们正处于 AI 革命的极早期；当前使用量相比 5-10 年后的规模微不足道。

views.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise AI tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业 AI 任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; it must fall significantly, making AI like software with negligible marginal cost.
views.zh: AI 成本是企业头号关切；成本必须大幅下降，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本可忽略。

views.en: Startups' biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition; even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
views.zh: 初创公司最大的挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10% 的企业需求。

views.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lacking tenured employees' deep context; investing in context graphs is crucial.
views.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深度上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, letting agents automate hypothesis generation, simulation, and data analysis.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，让智能体自动化地完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
views.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

views.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near-100% efficacy.
views.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

views.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; within 8-10 years we add over a year per year lived.
views.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近；8–10 年内，每活一年将多获得一年以上寿命。

views.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the real existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
views.zh: 我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能；真正的生存威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: Data quality, not scale alone, drives AI progress; benchmarks are misleading and RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 高质量数据而非单纯堆人力才是 AI 训练关键；基准测试常误导人，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 或许无法达到，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

views.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards steers AI toward slop; proper human evals are the gold standard.
views.zh: 为参与度和排行榜优化会把 AI 引向低质内容；严谨的人类评估才是黄金标准。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, so every company should train its own.
views.zh: 不同前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

views.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must trump accuracy, and omission is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 在医学中，AI 幻觉使人类判断更为关键；安全必须优先于准确，而遗漏才是最大风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
views.zh: 早期工作用大语言模型模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

views.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents.
views.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示词的大语言模型；AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会。

views.en: Simulation should represent human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
views.zh: 模拟应体现人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性的智能；合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

views.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation must model the 'dark knowledge' of real behavior.
views.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把预测准确率提升到 85%；模拟必须建模真实行为的“暗知识”。

views.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems; simulation shapes the future, not just predicts it.
views.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题；模拟不只是预测未来，而是塑造未来。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数与最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

views.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; human bias in architecture design should be removed in favor of systematic search.
views.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；架构设计中的人类偏见应被移除，转而依靠系统性搜索。

views.en: Attention remains crucial but not sufficient; simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models, while embodiment and adaptivity are needed at scale.
views.zh: 注意力机制依然关键但不充分；更小的专用模型用简单门控卷积即可，而大规模下还需要具身与自适应性。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业保有数据主权。

views.en: Customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference; static evals become obsolete as continuous adaptation is required in production.
views.zh: 定制化 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮；静态评测在生产中过时，持续自适应成为必需。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel agent rollouts beat human mathematicians.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“苦干”性驱动，而非形式化；可并行扩展的智能体式 rollout 比人类数学家更具优势，Lean 形式化被高估。

views.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系型角色仍将稳定，人类理解依然重要。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work, which matters for truth and careers, not just manners.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，这关乎真理与学术生涯，而不只是礼貌问题。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI video/images are toxic due to brand damage.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不该用于核心创意工作；AI 生成视频或图像会因品牌损害而有害，而非仅质量差。

views.en: The next math benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions; millennium problems may not translate to economic value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 在数学上的下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值，洞见的验证循环可长达数百年。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; other verticals like science and finance will follow.
views.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；科学与金融等垂直领域将随之跟进。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; the success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功指标应是客户成果，而非用户停留时长。

views.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI；他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

views.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity; startups win through focus, and deep understanding of code still matters.
views.zh: 软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会；初创公司靠专注取胜，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式回忆与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低几个数量级。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调效率与智能不可分割：用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，单纯靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；持续学习将走向端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics now dominate AI: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导 AI：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

views.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
views.zh: 稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存内存成本但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays exist to reduce that overhead.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；乘累加与脉动阵列的存在正是为了降低这一开销。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
views.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐量达到 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件、硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Model cost per quality improves ~60x/year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortage and a CPU demand inflection.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：给定质量下模型成本每年约改善 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式工作流导致多年内存短缺，并推动 CPU 需求拐点。

views.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：算力正快速向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，从而加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous multi-silicon and Chinese chips advance.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月：算力从未如此难租；随着异构多芯片与中国芯片进步，CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Proven, Better, New——复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并假定新想法必然失败；直觉胜过点子。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本，必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补课。

views.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise, though infra spending may be a bubble.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，尽管基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

views.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and test more ideas in a week than the industry tests in a year.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月：创始人应保持控制权，早期亲力亲为地微观管理，一周内测试的想法要多于行业一整年。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision is underappreciated, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉被低估，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

views.en: Transformers are natively set models, not sequence models; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than derive causal laws.
views.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置编码才注入顺序；LLM 只是拟合模式，未必能从数据中推导出牛顿定律这类因果理论。

views.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; GPU scaling is hitting limits.
views.zh: 学界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味 Scaling（规模扩张）模型；GPU 的算力扩张正逼近极限。

views.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds.
views.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成并模拟世界。

views.en: No single definition of world models exists; future unified systems will combine planning, simulation, and rendering, needing millions of tokens of context.
views.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义；未来统一系统将融合规划、模拟与渲染，并需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
