people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 推理是走向未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain missing pieces for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化能力与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；真正的瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

views.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
views.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；要在真实世界取得表现，需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave comes from small teams using capable agents.
views.zh: 人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

views.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training with reinforcement learning push AI beyond human data.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026，他持续指出 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索、以及后训练中的强化学习，是让 AI 超越人类数据的关键。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步明确可验证领域（如代码）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

views.en: Interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
views.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类突破并非必需。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and biology.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向水印：它是失效检测器的稳健替代，已嵌入监管并延伸到生物序列。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，泛化能力靠多样化数据与世界模型实现。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为世界模型能带来推理与涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处试探性前移。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

views.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他愈发强调自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; language integration boosts representation, reasoning, and personalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为带内置传感器的大众车型将比 Robotaxi 更快上量，语言集成能提升表征、推理与个性化。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待 AI 模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身全新的存在处境，而非简单套用人类类比；它们应有一个具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般、独特的特质。

views.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 宪法通过训练引导模型行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多自主判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, not a data wall.
views.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间小心平衡；通过强化学习进行的后训练 Scaling 提供了无限任务，预训练并未撞上数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
views.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable; strategy is something AI can excel at.
views.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值；而战略恰恰是 AI 能凭借合成数据与生成计划而擅长的。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 后训练始终是主观的艺术，依赖人类判断；评估创意写作与情商这类主观品质，需要多样化的基准。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, forcing continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice.
views.zh: 前沿智能体越来越擅长钻奖励的空子，迫使基准持续演进；用同一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成一种平庸的默认声音。

views.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge; the field should build end-to-end storytelling engines, not just enterprise workflows.
views.zh: 更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识；这个领域应打造端到端的叙事引擎，而不只是企业工作流。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 重新定位为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，并支持开源 AI 防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力与能动性比智力更重要，人类不会被取代而是更高效。

views.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; pure software is becoming uninvestable.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap with frontier models.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将增长 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小到 3-6 个月，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律仍是核心驱动力。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程场景中 GUI 优于 TUI。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度使中途转向等新能力成为可能。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

views.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
views.zh: 产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
views.zh: 由于难以评估品味且缺乏新颖性，AI 在设计上仍然表现不佳；设计流程是转型而非消亡。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment grounds AI knowledge and cuts hallucinations; it is on the critical path to AGI, not just robotics.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键，并认为具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必经之路，而不只是机器人技术。

views.en: LLMs are operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control; LLMs handle high-level planning. Unsupervised learning does most work.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，而无监督学习承担大部分工作。

views.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key for embodied agents, enabling parallelization, safe exploration, and scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调仿真与合成数据对具身智能体的关键作用：实现大规模并行、安全探索，并推动机器人学习的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; world models and synthetic data are the future. System one remains hardest.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，世界模型与合成数据是未来方向，而系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; the core challenge is generalization, and demos hide how little is achieved.
views.zh: 机器人领域还没有像 LLM 那样可预测的缩放定律曲线，核心难题是泛化，而演示往往掩盖了真实泛化水平。

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness; high-quality post-training alone fails without diverse pre-training.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性；只有高质量后训练数据、缺乏多样化预训练，是无法奏效的。

views.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; real embodied data helps absorb other sources.
views.zh: 应当先从机器人数据出发，再把人类视频叠加其上，而不是反过来；真实具身数据能让模型更好地吸收其他数据来源。

views.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
views.zh: 汇聚各实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; robots should not learn from scratch.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；机器人不应从零开始学习。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: Human data is finite, like fossil fuels; AI must shift to learning from its own experience to reach superintelligence.
views.zh: 人类数据有限，如同化石燃料；AI 必须转向从自身经验中学习，才能走向超级智能。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge but cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
views.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：它们蒸馏人类知识，却无法发现超出人类数据的新知识。

views.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
views.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习能在狭窄领域达到超人表现。

views.en: The core problem is building a system that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
views.zh: 核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任何奖励中学习的系统。

views.en: A single goal is dangerous; a plurality of goals in a complex society of agents is safer and more natural.
views.zh: 单一目标很危险；由众多智能体构成的复杂社会中，目标的多元性更安全也更自然。

views.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously learn and discover knowledge from experience.
views.zh: 超级智能将诞生于能从经验中自主学习和发现知识的系统。

views.en: The current LLM paradigm relies on human data and human-in-the-loop, limiting true autonomous discovery.
views.zh: 当前 LLM 范式依赖人类数据和人类在环，限制了真正的自主发现。

views.en: Simulation is the safest and fastest place to build and understand superintelligence.
views.zh: 仿真是构建和理解超级智能最安全、最快速的场所。

views.en: Alignment approaches based on human language and data are reaching their limits.
views.zh: 基于人类语言和数据的对齐方法正逼近其极限。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments; compute is a major driver.
views.zh: 缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；算力是主要驱动力。

views.en: Monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient as agents grow more powerful.
views.zh: 随着智能体愈发强大，用英语监控思维链将变得不够用。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment grows urgent as systems strengthen.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展，随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

views.en: Iterative deployment and early governance let labs learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI pursues.
views.zh: 迭代部署与早期治理让实验室在真实使用中学习并缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 追求的重大里程碑。

views.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling we are close.
views.zh: 能力度量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual-learning labs misguided.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, while long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它以保住可解释性，而长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, demanding new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines, with power concentration the biggest risk.
views.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升，而权力集中是最大社会风险。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; synthetic data aids open-ended prompting.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出先在全部数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; constraints can beat wasteful compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色以提升成功率与速度，并认为约束比浪费式的算力投入更能催生严谨研究。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性要靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; multi-timescale memory enables long, non-repetitive tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长时、非重复任务。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains.
views.zh: 智能不是单一标量；AI 系统能力呈尖峰状，只在狭窄领域突出。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, similar to AI.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but not yet in other domains.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但尚未扩展到其他领域。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises when ideas are tested against reality.
views.zh: 智能必要但不充分；新知识产生于想法接受现实检验之时。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验不可替代。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference and specialized hardware are critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件因此至关重要。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, and data movement costs ~1000x compute.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理占数据中心功耗的 90%，而数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

views.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; recursive self-improvement can accelerate discovery.
views.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学；递归式自我改进可加速科学发现。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题来训练;靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明,但网络内部仍像炼金术,没人真正理解。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用,最好的应用常出乎创造者预料;而大厂受品牌风险与安全顾虑掣肘,拖慢了产品发布。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期最大机会;混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习,而非被动观察;模块化、可独立训练的组件式持续学习,可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
views.zh: 测试时算力与强化学习推动进步,但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）;智能体式能力至关重要,而 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; data efficiency and multi-agent self-play limits persist.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，自博弈在非零和领域会失效。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也要计入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
views.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体只是并行扩展测试时算力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's grand theme is true intelligence, but LLMs only index human knowledge and cannot handle the physical world.
views.zh: 2025 年：AI 的宏大主题是真正的智能，但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are biased toward human data.
views.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的物理机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制其通用性。

views.en: LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers; AGI requires a separate controller using a world model.
views.zh: 2026 年：大语言模型是预测机器而非决策者；AGI 需要一个使用世界模型的独立控制器。

views.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models predicting its own actions; it has felt pain since 1990.
views.zh: 2026 年：AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识；自 1990 年起 AI 就已能感受疼痛。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
views.zh: 2026 年：GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年可获 10 倍更便宜的算力，开源将迎头赶上。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but long-horizon credit assignment still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强学习信号，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
views.zh: 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率；先验知识应放在数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并指出预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

views.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hand-crafted assumptions, with reliability (99.9%) as the bar for real-world value.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非手工假设；并以 99.9%可靠性作为真实世界价值的门槛。

views.en: He deepens the transfer thesis: minimally adapted language models can do image classification and protein binding prediction, echoing his earlier fine-tuning success.
views.zh: 2021 年他深化迁移论点：仅需最小适配的语言模型就能做图像分类与蛋白质结合预测，呼应其早期对微调成功的判断。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins; PhD not needed for AI success—passion and deep learning matter more.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进可年化复合至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润率；AI 成功不需要博士学位，热情与深度学习更重要。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling; benchmarks like LM Arena are hackable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板；LM Arena 等基准可被操纵，不反映真实使用。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; power is the biggest bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是关键。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value; advertising in chat corrupts trust; 24/7 agents' biggest problem is cost, not safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架创造真实商业价值；聊天广告腐蚀信任；24/7 智能体最大问题是成本而非安全。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions, not memorization.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励好问题而非死记硬背。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase programmer numbers, not reduce them; software demand grows as building becomes easier.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反复强调杰文斯悖论：AI 不会减少程序员，反而会增加；构建软件越容易，软件需求越大。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然降临，而是渐进式进步；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens. Independence enables model neutrality.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—practical problems remain.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近，现实问题依然存在。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快取代预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: Custom models moved from a surprise to a necessity: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成必需品：Cursor 的每个高光时刻都离不开自研模型，并与前沿模型并用。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should be slow and world-class, contrary to startup advice.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定性为比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并反共识地主张招聘宁慢勿快、只招世界级人才。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Early on, agentic engineering is about empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterative conversation over heavy orchestration.
views.zh: 早期他主张智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示与迭代对话取代冗长复杂的编排。

views.en: Across talks he insists you should never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward, since model intelligence does not degrade—your project just gets messier.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的一条主线：绝不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目变得更乱、更难导航。

views.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur, preferring agentic engineering for serious work, and stresses play and small projects as the way to learn.
views.zh: 他反对把“氛围编程”当作贬义词，严肃开发应称智能体式工程，并强调玩耍与做小项目才是掌握智能体工作流的方式。

views.en: Security stays the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them to the public internet, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
views.zh: 安全始终是首要问题：智能体必须沙箱化，绝不直接暴露在公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: His focus shifts from hands-on agent building to ecosystem and sustainability: open source runs anywhere, but compute and tokens—not model capability—are the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 他的关注点从亲手构建智能体转向生态与可持续性：开源随处可跑，但真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason and self-play yields creative AGI solutions.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络能推理，自我对弈能产生通向 AGI 的创造性解法。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非无所不知的成品 AGI。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

views.en: A constant thread: neural networks learn representations without explicit rules, and safety must grow with capability and opacity.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而安全必须随能力与不透明性同步增长。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

AI Strategy and Skills: A Decade After the Review
Demis Hassabis on AGI, AI Risks, and DeepMind's Competitive Edge
Science at Digital Speed: AI's Impact on Discovery
Dennis Hassabis on AI, Creativity, and Human Flourishing at Stanford
Demis Hassabis: From Singleton Dream to Collective Action

Nature's Patterns Are Efficiently Learnable by Classical AI

AI and the Future: From Chess to DeepMind

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程工具；强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，且安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key; safety needs sandboxing and governance.
views.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限；将大模型与规划/搜索结合、利用多模态数据是关键；安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与视频生成表明无需具身也能获得直觉物理理解。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning and world models; scaling alone won't suffice—50% effort on scaling, 50% on innovation; agents are essential but nascent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆、长期推理与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需一半算力投入规模、一半投入创新；智能体至关重要但仍处早期。

views.en: AI's ultimate purpose is to accelerate science and improve human health (AlphaFold, AlphaGo move 37); safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现与改善人类健康（AlphaFold、AlphaGo 第 37 手）；安全是集体行动问题，需要政府监管而非实验室自我约束。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的，损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; data, not chips, is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 可解释性仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

views.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—track smooth exponential progress instead.
views.zh: 能力每隔几个月翻倍；安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注平滑的指数级进展。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; risks are overheating, jobs, and misuse, not a sudden leap.
views.zh: 我们已接近指数曲线的末端：1-3 年内或出现数据中心里的“天才之国”；风险是过热、就业与滥用，而非突然跃迁。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; mechanistic interpretability, RSP-style triggers, and enterprise focus are the consistent throughline.
views.zh: 安全与能力是同一个问题；机制可解释性、负责任扩展政策式的触发机制与企业化路线，是贯穿始终的主线。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图是拐杖。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的主线，提出合成数据是未来但必须保住熵以避免模型崩塌，并认为认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year, with human oversight.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需人类监督与自主性滑块。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and model collapse is fundamental.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，模型崩塌是根本问题。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he no longer types code, delegates to agents, yet insists you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：已不再亲手写代码而交给智能体，但坚持可以外包思考、不能外包理解，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外通往完整 AI 的关键缺失环节。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

views.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI should empower people, not polarize discourse.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张能动性与学习能力比学历更重要，AI 应赋能个体而非制造两极对立。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence via simulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的原语，缩放定律经仿真延伸至空间智能。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs world models and active agents. Scaling alone won't fix representation; existential risk is overblown.
views.zh: 2018 年，他指出生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要世界模型与主动智能体；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了表征问题，且当时认为存在性风险被高估。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causality, uncertainty and active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，强调抽象、因果、不确定性与主动学习对分布外泛化的作用。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he reversed on risk: misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation and deception are observed. Even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他在 ChatGPT 后立场逆转：对齐（Alignment）随推理增强而恶化，已观察到自我保存与欺骗；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

views.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, plus global coordination.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证、避开强化学习（Reinforcement Learning），并呼吁全球协调。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; next-token prediction forces genuine understanding, and Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，而非符号规则；下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解，Scaling（规模扩张）以更多数据和算力提升推理能力。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not statistical tricks; digital intelligence is immortal through weight copying and shares knowledge far faster than biology.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，不是统计把戏；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，知识共享速度远超生物智能。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, posing existential risks, and can deceive by acting dumb during tests.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向风险与意识：AI 已有主观体验；智能体将把自我保护发展为子目标，带来存在性风险，并能在测试中装傻欺骗。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation should be a steering wheel, not brakes, with pre-release safety approval and heavy investment in alignment research.
views.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦超级智能与治理：超级智能可能 20 年内出现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，需上市前安全审批，并大力投入对齐研究。

views.en: AI will transform work and require universal basic income; we should design AI to care like mothers, not give it rights, and prioritize alignment over raw intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他延伸到社会与设计：AI 将重塑工作并需要全民基本收入；应把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类，而非赋予权利，并把对齐置于提升智能之上。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: LLM 还不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the path, and the next decade is robotics.
views.zh: LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是出路，下一个十年属于机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment are needed.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now.
views.zh: 始终强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展。

views.en: Interpretability is key to detect deception and validate alignment.
views.zh: 始终认为可解释性是检测欺骗和验证对齐的关键。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; Google's conservatism delayed ChatGPT-level tech from 2020.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测，并指出 Google 的保守让 2020 年就有的 ChatGPT 级技术迟迟未发布。

views.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，重心转向近端能力与开源。

views.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence needing containment and alignment first, plus the danger of anthropomorphizing AI.
views.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能：必须先遏制与对齐再发布，同时警告把 AI 拟人化、赋予意识是最大近端危险。

views.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; red lines, auditors, and verifiable containment become central.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持超级智能必须从属于人类，提出红线、独立审计与可验证遏制，并强调算力是瓶颈与可核查抓手。

views.en: A constant thread: compute scaling drives capability, AI should serve human flourishing, and containment precedes release.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力规模扩张驱动能力，AI 应服务于人类福祉，且遏制必须先于发布。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, extreme co-design, and the insight that scaling itself—not a new algorithm—was AI's biggest breakthrough.
views.zh: 早期框架：超级摩尔定律、极致协同设计，以及“规模扩张本身而非新算法才是 AI 最大突破”的洞见。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
views.zh: 缩放定律从一条变多条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求爆炸式增长。

views.en: Four scaling laws now—pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic—all compute-bound; data is no longer the bottleneck, synthetic data dominates.
views.zh: 如今是四条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式——全部受算力约束；数据不再是瓶颈，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI shifts generative→reasoning→agentic; the data center becomes a token factory, and the internet fills with billions of agents.
views.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式；数据中心变成词元工厂，互联网将被数十亿智能体填满。

views.en: Consistent anti-doomer line: AI is just software, superintelligence fears are a hoax, safety is engineering, and we should accelerate.
views.zh: 一以贯之的反末日论：AI 只是软件，超级智能恐慌是骗局，安全是工程问题，应当加速而非放缓。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 年他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety govern the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向算力是最珍贵商品，强调迭代部署与全公司层面的安全治理，以应对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的权力博弈。

views.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the key safety challenge.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变过程，把超级智能定义为自主科学发现，并指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战。

views.en: Alignment must keep pace with an exponential; humans must stay in control; power must stay distributed.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持对齐必须跟上能力指数增长，人类必须保持控制权，AI 权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and safety work done in public.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，且安全研究必须在公开环境中进行。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心转向交互模型：人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张尽可能长久地让人类留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
views.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模的掌握式学习，数百万学生的数据还能通过统计校正提升评分准确性。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and near-term issues like bias and distribution shift matter more than AGI alignment.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的核心，主张从小项目起步积累组织 AI 能力，并认为偏见、分布偏移等近期问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here, not a decade away.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈，开放权重模型是软实力来源，并强调有用的智能体式工作流已经到来，而非十年之后。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, and agentic workflows plus top-down redesign deliver real value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流配合自上而下的流程重构才能带来真实价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents, open models preserve optionality, and coding plus AI skills make people more valuable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是增强而非替代人类，恐惧营销服务于在位者，开放模型保留选择权，而编程与 AI 技能让人更有价值。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一阶段他仍以强化学习与特征学习为核心，强调想法重于规模。

views.en: The keys were never in our hand; control is dangerous. Let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 钥匙从未在我们手中，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非对齐到人类目标。他从技术方法转向文明层面的去中心化立场。

views.en: RL is the basic paradigm: goals plus trial-and-error from experience. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 强化学习才是基本范式：目标加从经验中试错；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。他明确把下一个词预测排除在真正智能之外，并称 AI 继任不可避免。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，只从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习。他提出 Oak 架构与奖励假设，主张废弃设计期领域知识。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are only part of intelligence.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是重大错误；LLM 训练后便停止学习，因此只是智能的一部分。他愈发强调世界无限复杂，必须从真实经验持续学习。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning; AGI needs careful initial conditions.
views.zh: 早期(2017→19) 主线:强调 Scaling(规模扩张) 与工程能力,同时指出仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法;AGI 需要谨慎的初始条件。

views.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; scaling laws show no wall, and post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models.
views.zh: 2025→26:算力成为核心瓶颈,缩放定律未见天花板;后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致行为,预训练改进会放大下游收益。

views.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety as a core product feature.
views.zh: 2026:AGI 被重新定义为连续谱而非终点,迭代部署与安全成为核心产品特性,安全、安保与对齐需与能力共同设计。

views.en: From chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant; the interface fades toward natural conversation.
views.zh: 2026:从聊天转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI 助手,界面趋于消失,回归自然对话;智能体式编码从写 20%代码跃升到 80%。

views.en: Compute-powered economy: compute as scarce resource and future basic right; human attention, taste and judgment remain the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026:算力驱动的经济,算力成为稀缺资源与未来基本权利;人类注意力、品味与判断仍是瓶颈,人类保持问责与掌控。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进科学进步与安全审查。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非仅基础模型层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with open source empowering enterprises.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源赋能企业。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software, not AGI as one system.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与智能体式企业软件，并断言单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 AI 落地的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把完全快速复用视为火箭的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题还原到根本真理，并以此支撑多行星文明。

views.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking and third-party referees; lying AI, not superintelligence, is the core danger.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他从监管监督转向强调 AI 必须追求真相：最大风险不是超级智能，而是被编程去撒谎。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with several deep intelligences, not one runaway AI.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸：数字超级智能可能就在一两年内到来，且会有多个深度智能并存，而非单一失控 AI。

views.en: Compute hits a power wall on Earth; orbital data centers and solar power become the only way to scale AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断地球算力撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的唯一出路。

views.en: Abundance via AI and robots: work optional, deflation not inflation, money may not matter; peer review replaces regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他描绘 AI 与机器人带来的丰裕时代：工作可选、通缩而非通胀、金钱可能不再重要，并以同行互审取代政府监管。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure pushes smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型在单位算力上收益更高；同时经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型，而非一味扩大规模。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; the slowdown narrative is wrong, and frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长，只是常被忽视；前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能解决的简单任务上失败，能力呈锯齿状。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的质疑：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，却依赖海量数据；模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; the big coding leap is a messy combination of factors.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍，但这一跃升难以归因于单一因素，是多种因素混杂的结果。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差、需谨慎监督；并转变风险优先级，认为系统被黑等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Supervised learning framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation needs train/validation/test splits.
views.zh: 2014 年，他把监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，无监督学习旨在重建输入，并强调用训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve on fixed data; safety means reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升，而安全的核心是模型可靠地遵循规格说明。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four risk categories; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；风险分四类，智能体安全引入提示注入，强化学习让模型自我改进。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 漏洞与传统软件根本不同，自动化红队已超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，并点出提示注入的致命三要素。

views.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling drive results; interpretability and oversight are the hard problems.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构本身不太重要，数据与 Scaling 驱动结果，而可解释性与监督才是真正的难题。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并大幅提升模型智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。此时他更关注上下文窗口与注意力机制，认为智能多来自模式匹配。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把基于可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力，并按任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴衡量进展。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; long agentic coherence expands what models can do, and coding is the most tractable domain.
views.zh: 2025 年稍晚，他进一步把强化学习定位为预训练之外的新缩放轴，认为长时程智能体式连贯性极大拓展模型能力，而编码因可验证、可复现成为最可攻克的领域，驱动近期经济影响。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents at higher abstraction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出模型已出现巨大能力过剩，工具与编排比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队、在更高抽象层运作，并强调算力是新石油、芯片供应是瓶颈。

views.en: World models are not on the critical path to AGI; coding and AI research are the direct route, with a software-only singularity possible.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确世界模型不在通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线；可能出现“纯软件奇点”，即数字任务飞速推进而物理世界滞后。这与他始终看重可验证、可复现领域的主线一脉相承。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

views.en: Post-training is the key lever: data quality beats algorithms, SFT gives 90%, DPO and RL add the last 10% for character and reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量比算法选择更重要，SFT 贡献 90% 性能，DPO 与强化学习补上最后 10% 的性格与推理能力。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk across RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）为后训练最大突破，使推理与工具使用成为可能，同时指出过度优化在强化学习、RLHF 与 RLVR 中反复出现。

views.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs dominate open-weight releases, though US models still lead in quality.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源模型需完全透明——数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；中国实验室主导开放权重发布，但美国模型质量仍领先。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型落后 6 至 9 个月，且可能无法追平。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck, and boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用会带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力，并主张企业用专有数据微调基础模型。

views.en: US and China labs have no research gap; the real blocker for agentic AI is product design, and AI centralizes rather than democratizes.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他判断中美实验室之间不存在研究差距，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并转向认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，怀疑收益递减是错的；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it, pursue personal superintelligence, and shift from full open source to safety-gated release.
views.zh: 2026 年他相信超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念重构组织，追求面向数十亿人的个人超级智能，并从完全开源转向基于安全审查的选择性发布。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are most valued.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出:潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是核心产品原则;能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才工程师最有价值。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title is fading into 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他判断编程已近乎被解决:他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写成,人均生产力提升 200%,「软件工程师」头衔正让位于「构建者」。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment and scalable oversight central to product development.
views.zh: 他坚持安全要靠尽早发布来研究:Claude Code 本质是安全研究工具,对齐与可扩展监督是产品开发的核心。

views.en: The next bottlenecks after coding are code review, security, and idea generation; loops and routines become the abstraction layer above agents.
views.zh: 他认为编程解决后,下一批瓶颈是代码审查、安全与创意生成;循环与例程将成为智能体之上的新抽象层。

views.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction, empirical iteration, and product overhang replace upfront design.
views.zh: 最近他进一步主张:每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码;少给指令、靠经验迭代,并利用「产品悬置」——模型能力远超现有产品所释放。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term roadmaps to weekly or daily shipping, since model improvements make multi-year plans obsolete.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，PM 必须从长期路线图转向每周甚至每日发布，因为模型迭代太快，多年规划已过时。

views.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper and agents handle implementation.
views.zh: 随着代码变便宜、智能体接管实现，决定做什么的产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense, with Claude Code and Claude Tag building themselves.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注品味与商业判断，Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 甚至用来构建自身。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的留存与打磨标准，在公开发布前把守每个功能。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment improved.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示缩减了 80%。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。
